summary: vmware.vmware_rest no longer depends on cloud.common, so it isn't installed automatically anymore.
questions: Does vmware_rest still install cloud.common automatically?

answer_card.title: vmware_rest drops cloud.common dependency
answer_card.answer_md: `cloud.common` is no longer a dependency of vmware.vmware_rest and won't be installed automatically. Install it manually if you still need it.
